# Hachimi.ai · 哈基米道长

> Hachimi.ai (哈基米道长) is an app for Zi Wei Dou Shu and Ba Zi charts and Mei Hua Yi Shu question casting, where you can ask Hachimi for an AI-written reading. A tool built for professional fate readers.

## Home page

- [Hachimi.ai](https://hachimi.ai/en): When it's a lot, cast a hexagram.
- [Enter a birth once, get both charts](https://hachimi.ai/en#what): Zi Wei and Ba Zi chart from one case, no switching tools; true solar time is worked out once from the birthplace, and both charts use it.
- [Your clients' cases stay in your hands](https://hachimi.ai/en#what): No account needed. iPhone and iPad sync through your iCloud, and on Android your phone's system backup carries them to your Google Account. You can also export a backup file, and the device keeps a daily one.
- [Switch Zi Wei styles, read Ba Zi to six pillars](https://hachimi.ai/en#what): Zi Wei switches between San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations, cycles down to the hour; Ba Zi adds a six-pillar pro chart with its cycles.
- [One case per person](https://hachimi.ai/en#case): One case per client. Zi Wei, Ba Zi and every hexagram cast for them sit under that one case.
- [Mei Hua Yi Shu casting](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): Say two numbers and the hexagram is cast on your phone. AI writes the reading; the hexagram does not move.
- [Zi Wei Dou Shu](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations; five cycle layers; patterns judged by rule.
- [Ba Zi charting](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): The four-pillar table reads from main star to symbolic stars; the six-pillar table carries major, annual and monthly cycles.
- [Case library](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): Casts travel with the case; among dozens of clients, filter by group or day master and the person is right there.
- [Academy](https://hachimi.ai/en#academy): 154 public-domain classics ship with the app, filed under the five arts, readable offline.
- [On-device charting](https://hachimi.ai/en#offline): Zi Wei and Ba Zi are computed on this phone; charts come out offline.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://hachimi.ai/en#faq): Is this real fortune telling? Do the same numbers give the same hexagram? Do I need internet to chart? How do San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations differ? Can I lose my cases? How does the Master remember what I asked? Who writes the reading?
- [Get the app](https://hachimi.ai/en#download): Install Hachimi.ai and enter your first client.

## How it's built

- [How hexagram casting and chart building work](https://hachimi.ai/en/methodology): Here is how a hexagram is cast, where a third party AI service is held back and by what, and what rules shape a chart. The Master walks you through it, step by step.
- [How the chart is built](https://hachimi.ai/en/methodology#paipan): Both charts, Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star astrology) and Ba Zi (Four Pillars), come from the chart engine built into the app, running on your own phone. Same birth details, same Star Settings, same chart every time. A few spots cause the most differences, and the rules are here.

## Privacy

Section 1. Summary of the [Privacy Policy](https://hachimi.ai/en/privacy), last updated 2026-10-01:

- No account is needed. The App tells installations apart with a randomly generated **anonymous install identifier**, which you can reset at any time under Me > Privacy and data.
- Online readings need your consent first. Once you agree, your question, clarification and the reading are stored on the Company's backend together with the anonymous install identifier, and the text is **deleted after 90 days**. We use it to improve reading quality.
- Cases, reading history and Hachimi's memory are stored on your device. On iOS they sync through iCloud to your own iCloud; the Android version has no cloud sync and is saved to your Google Account with the system backup.
- We do not sell your data, do not use it for advertising, and do not track you across other apps or websites. The App does not read any advertising identifier, including the iOS IDFA and the Android advertising ID, so it never shows an App Tracking Transparency request.
- The App integrates no third-party analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK. Usage statistics and crash diagnostics go only to the Company's backend.
